Vendored, unmodified, so the UI needs no build step or package manager.

- `preact-htm.js`: `htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.module.js` (Preact 10 + htm), npm integrity verified. Licences: `LICENSE-preact` (MIT), `LICENSE-htm` (Apache-2.0).
- `../fonts/`: IBM Plex Mono 400/500/600 latin from `@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono@5.3.0`, and Archivo variable (wdth axis) latin from `@fontsource-variable/archivo@5.3.0`. Both SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `../fonts/LICENSE-*`.
